career_summary: Focus on building foundational machine learning knowledge and practical project experience using Python and data manipulation libraries to bridge the gap toward a Machine Learning Engineer role.

skill_gaps.reason: Statistics forms the mathematical foundation required to understand data distributions, evaluate model performance, and make data-driven decisions during feature engineering. Without a strong grasp of statistical concepts, an engineer cannot effectively validate hypotheses or diagnose why a model fails in production.

Scikit-learn is the industry-standard library for implementing traditional machine learning algorithms, data preprocessing, and model evaluation pipelines. Mastery of this tool is essential for quickly prototyping, training, and deploying baseline models before moving to more complex architectures.

Deep learning is crucial for solving complex, high-dimensional problems involving unstructured data such as images, audio, and natural language. A Machine Learning Engineer must understand these neural network architectures to build state-of-the-art predictive systems.

PyTorch is one of the leading frameworks for researching and building dynamic deep learning models due to its flexibility and intuitive pythonic design. Knowing this framework allows engineers to efficiently implement, debug, and scale advanced neural networks for production environments.

MLOps bridges the gap between model development and operational deployment by automating pipelines for continuous integration, monitoring, and retraining. Having this skill ensures that machine learning models remain reliable, scalable, and performant over time in real-world production systems.

roadmap.goal: Build the core mathematical and statistical foundation required to understand data distributions and evaluate model performance.
Master traditional machine learning algorithms, data preprocessing, and baseline model evaluation pipelines.
Gain expertise in complex neural network architectures and leading deep learning frameworks to solve high-dimensional problems.
Apply learned concepts to build, scale, and automate reliable machine learning pipelines for real-world production environments.
Consolidate your technical skills and portfolio projects to successfully interview for Machine Learning Engineer positions.

Kaggle Learn - Intro to Deep Learning
Kaggle Datasets (apply statistics to real data)
